reading: US Attorney General Todd Blanche praised Nvidia but refused to say whether the company was under federal investigation.
Huang was reinstated less than two weeks after being forced to resign.
Huang is due to appear before Congress next week to answer questions about national security concerns.
These concerns involve his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy who led Megaspeed, a customer of Nvidia based in Singapore.
The US commerce department said it was preparing to blacklist Megaspeed, meaning it planned to place the company under official restrictions.
The commerce and justice departments said they began investigating Megaspeed in 2024 over possible violations of rules limiting chip exports.
Nvidia's board said it was confident that giving Huang his position back posed no national security risk.
Trump said he had spoken to Nvidia's directors and convinced them to bring Huang back.
The board said its decision served the best interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers.
Nvidia's share price rose more than 31% on Monday after the news that Huang would lead the company again.
The share price closed down nearly 6%, although it remained above its level at the end of the previous week.
Huang reportedly apologised to Nvidia employees on Tuesday and said he had made serious mistakes.

vocabulary.definition: Given back a position that someone had previously lost.

Successfully persuaded someone to believe something or take an action.
The amount someone pays to buy one unit of ownership in a company.
Said sorry for something done wrong.
